notes:
REF-BM-02: Collects title, description, and favicon, but not a preview image.
REF-BM-03: Title and description can be edited after saving, but the UI provides no pre-save metadata review/edit step.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but bookmark notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate saves reuse and highlight the existing item, but do not take the user into editing it.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and URL, but notes are neither stored nor searched.
REF-BM-14: Search does not parse #tag syntax; the hash is treated as ordinary substring text.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators, grouping, and literal-operator quoting are not parsed.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase search is not implemented.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: No multi-selection or bulk actions exist.
REF-BM-21: No filtered-collection bulk action exists.
REF-BM-22: Results use a fixed creation-date ordering with no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-23: Notes and markdown rendering are unsupported.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are unsupported.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshots are unsupported.
REF-BM-26: Bookmarks cannot be archived.
REF-BM-27: No reversible archive state exists to distinguish from permanent deletion.
REF-BM-28: No archived-bookmarks view exists.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are unsupported.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is unsupported.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is unsupported.
REF-BM-32: No display-related personal settings are implemented.
